criteria.comment: Input handling and loop are correct, but the int accumulator overflows: verified failures on 4 of 10 tests (3, 6, 7, 10).
Readable and well structured; the sum needs a 64-bit type (long long). The overflow itself is marked under correctness.

The failures come from storing the sum in an int, which overflows for large sums; use long long. Rubric marks (teacher-approved): Logic & Correctness 1.50 of 3.00, Code Quality 1.50 of 2.00. Final mark: 6.00 of 10.00.
